block.comment: Straight stages100/150/190/230 accumulate centered time only. Brief F6/F12 trim keeps the current stage, outer wheel at stage PWM and inner minus30, for a shared30ms event. Centered30ms clears that event. Mild correction expiry uses curve output without clearing stage; centered30ms restores retained stage. Strong side/loss/confirmed outer resets stages. F10 is intercepted by a20ms bounded zero-output confirmation; repeated blips share a deadline until15ms valid line. Unexpected normal patterns stop.
Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.

Curve base174/gain174/minimum15 after45 percent increase from120/120/10. Straight stages100/150/190/230 retain brief F6/F12 trim without advancing during correction. Mild trim pauses stages; stable center restores retained stage. Strong side or confirmed outer resets stages.
Exclude A1/A5 from center F and weighted position. Their saved raw values now feed the separately confirmed outer sharp-turn assistance.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.

xml.comment: Start on the narrow line LEFT of the large finish patch, facing away from finish. Three-center-sensor control, sharp corners and short gaps. After departure/minimum run, sustained wide line latches finish stop. This is not measured lap localization. Button waits at boot only.

block.comment: A1=right/A5=left outer assistance. Center-only search gets at most150ms to capture line or receive confirmed outer support; otherwise stop. Outer evidence may correct it once without resetting the800ms total deadline. Confirmed outer plus matching F2/F8 starts before full loss. Outer forward150/inner reverse114; After actual loss, matching single edge also starts capture at100/20 or100/50. Active-turn F14 and post-capture F0 share a fixed60ms forward-only uncertainty budget; normal lift/finish marker handling is unchanged. Split F10 uses its own bounded confirmation. The150ms unsupported-search cutoff applies only before capture; the800ms total deadline stays fixed. Continuous15ms capture completes turn.

Gap base45. Qualified retained right direction uses45/15, left15/45, for at most120ms without fresh evidence; renewal does not refresh direction age. Unknown/expired direction uses45/45. Normal120ms deadline remains; LOSS_STOP_ENABLED0 uses forward fallback instead of F0 fault. Side-line return starts differential capture20/45 or30/45 immediately. Continuous narrow line15ms finishes; invalid observations reset confirmation, not the event deadline. Wide line returns to marker handling.

Lift: wide F14 confirms30ms but only arms a candidate. First non-wide sample must be centered F4 with no outer turn evidence; side/loss/split or active turn/gap cancels. Stop immediately on qualifying centered exit; user-requested wait23350ms from stop command, not measured settled feedback. This is below the published27s +/-5% timing. Auto exit PWM45 with1500ms limit. Consume marker once. PWM zero is not active braking. Disable LIFT_ENABLED for the earlier practice mat without a lift.
LED updates only on changes. Green=running; blue=outer-direction probe stop, lift wait, fault or finish. No per-loop NeoPixel show.
